# ForensiScope Evidence Review

Capability ID: forensiscope-evidence-review-v1
Commercial state: verification_required
Machine state: discovery_only
Public URL: https://evercraft-forensiscope.base44.app/video-too-large-for-ai
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

## Use this when

- this video is too large for the AI
- the chat will not take my video
- video too big for AI
- audio too large for AI
- analyze a long video
- review hours of footage
- transcribe and analyze this video
- make a timestamped timeline from this video
- compare two recordings
- review surveillance footage
- review video evidence
- analyze long-form evidence
- evidence timeline review
- media evidence integrity review

## Problem

An authorized user needs traceable analysis of video or long-form evidence while preserving source lineage and integrity boundaries.

## Inputs

Authorized evidence set, case context and requested review scope.

## Outputs

Source-lineage-preserving evidence analysis with custody events, timestamped findings and integrity review.

## Pricing

Published duration tiers are $15 up to 5 minutes, $35 up to 30 minutes, $75 up to 2 hours, $149 up to 6 hours and $249 up to 12 hours. Central machine checkout remains verification-gated.

## Invocation and authority

LIVE human-confirmed web handoff for AI media overflow and evidence review; secure machine intake and central checkout remain verification-gated.

Evidence authorization and payment confirmation are required. Secure machine intake remains disabled until current security tests pass.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments; central machine checkout remains verification-gated.

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
